topic: Improving data accuracy and model foundation
summary_markdown: Discussion focused on improving the speed and accuracy of delivery. The core concept involves sequentially increasing accuracy by adding sensors in low-accuracy areas and integrating SDK data. The model foundation was discussed, noting that the product remains consistent even when transitioning from Version 1 to Version 2. Data quality is key, requiring methods like manual counting and utilizing SDK data. Initial efforts included training 1600 sensors, with subsequent discussion suggesting a reduction in both sensor count (down to 900) and reliance on SDK data (down to 50).
decisions: The product version transition from V1 to V2 is noted.
